scalars.scalar_value: EDUCATION: Two years college level course work or the equivalent with specialized training in ornamental horticulture or a related field. EXPERIENCE: Increasingly responsible horticulture and landscape maintenance experience. Please visit Specialty Lab Technician III

items.item_text: 01. The assigned work hours for the substitute pool may be 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with occasional evening shifts from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Options: I am available to work shifts from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with occasional evening shifts from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. | I am unavailable to work shifts from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with occasional evening shifts from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.

02. I understand that with advanced notice I may be required to be flexible with my substitute assignment work schedule. Options: Yes, I understand and accept this work condition. | No, I do not accept and cannot adhere to this work condition.

03. I understand the duration of the substitute assignment is possibly as long as three (3) to six (6) months. Options: Yes, I understand and accept this work condition | No, I do not accept and cannot adhere to this work condition.

04. The following supplemental questions will help us determine if you meet the minimum qualification standards for this position. Additionally, the information provided in the answers to these questions will be considered if a scored evaluation of your training and experience is utilized during the assessment process. Respond honestly and truthfully to all questions. Over-evaluating your experience or skill level is considered providing false and/or misleading information. Applicants found to have provided false or misleading information of their skills or experience will be disqualified from further employment processing, or if hired, immediately terminated from employment. Experience listed below must be represented in the work history section of your application. A resume may be attached, but not substituted for completing the work history, education sections, or the supplemental questions of the employment application. Providing incomplete responses or answering "See Resume" or "See Application" may automatically disqualify your application from further consideration. I acknowledge that I have read and understand the above statement. Options: Yes | No

05. What is your highest level of education completed? Please Note: If hired, proof of education will be required during onboarding. Options: High School Diploma or G.E.D. Equivalent | Some College | Associate's Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate | None of the Above

06. If you have indicated a degree above, please state the area of concentration for your degree. If you have multiple degrees, please list all areas of concentration. If you did not indicate a degree, please answer N/A.

07. Do you have a certificate of California Department of Pesticide Regulation Qualified Applicators, Certificate Categories B & D (landscape maintenance and agriculture). ? Options: Yes, I have a California Department of Pesticide Regulation Qualified Applicators, Certificate Categories B & D (landscape maintenance and agriculture). . | No, I do not have a California Department of Pesticide Regulation Qualified Applicators, Certificate Categories B & D (landscape maintenance and agriculture).

08. How many years of full time paid increasingly responsible work experience do you have related to horticulture and landscape maintenance ? Your related work experience must be clearly shown in the areas for work history on your application. Options: I do not have any related work experience. | I have been trained in this area but have no related work experience. | I have less than 1 year of related work experience | I have more than 1 year but less than 2 years of related work experience. | I have more than 2 years but less than 4 years of related work experience. | I have more than 4 years but less than 6 years of related work experience. | I have more than 6 years but less than 8 years of related work experience. | I have more than 8 years but less than 10 years of related work experience. | I have more than 10 years of related work experience.

09. Please describe the experience you have indicated above related to horticulture and landscape maintenance. Be sure to include the following, in the format presented: EMPLOYER: JOB TITLE: NUMBER OF HOURS WORKED PER WEEK: SPECIFIC DUTIES PERFORMED RELATED TO HORTICULTURE AND LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE: The experience listed must be represented in the work history section of your application. A resume may be attached, but not substituted for completing the work history, education sections, or the supplemental questions of the employment application. Providing incomplete responses or answering "See Resume" or "See Application" or generic answers such as "I have many years of experience" which do not adequately address the specific content of the question may automatically disqualify your application from further consideration. If you have no experience, please answer N/A.

10. Please select the answer that best describes your experience working in the area of governmental, public schools, community colleges, and/or universities. Please check all that apply. Options: No Governmental, public schools, or community college work experience. | Governmental | Public School | Community College | University

11. If the job classification for which you are applying has positions available (either now or during the life of the eligibility list) at any of the following locations, which would you be willing to interview for and accept employment? The Grossmont-Cuyamaca Community College District Offices provide services which support both campuses and are currently located on the Grossmont College campus. Both colleges offer hundreds of programs and student services tailored to meet diverse needs, while leading the region with the highest transfers to SDSU, and providing premier career and workforce training. Grossmont College has been recognized as a Champion of Higher Education for its Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) program, and offers premier programs such as allied health, nursing, culinary arts, science, fine and performing arts, and drone technology. Cuyamaca College is ranked “Best for Vets” and recognized for excellence in Black Transfer-level Math Success. Cuyamaca offers over 100 degrees and certificate programs, including innovative programs like water/wastewater technology, automotive technology, engineering, graphic design, ornamental horticulture, and environmental health and safety management. PLEASE NOTE: If a location is NOT selected, you will not be considered for employment at that location. Please select all of interest. Options: Grossmont-Cuyamaca Community College District Offices | Cuyamaca College | Grossmont College
